paragraphs: On May 27, 2025, Kestrel Group LLC ("Kestrel LLC") and Maiden Holdings, Ltd. ("Maiden") completed their previously announced combination ("Combination"), forming a new, publicly listed specialty program group operating under the name Kestrel Group Ltd ("Kestrel Group" or "Parent Company"). The Combination was previously announced on December 30, 2024. Maiden shares ceased trading on the NASDAQ Capital Market ("Nasdaq") at close of market on May 27, 2025. Kestrel shares began trading on the Nasdaq at open of market on May 28, 2025 under the ticker symbol "KG". Upon the closing of the Transactions (the "Closing"), Maiden and Kestrel LLC are now wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company, which was rebranded as Kestrel Group and renamed "Kestrel Group Ltd" ("Kestrel").

The Combination creates a capital light, fee-based insurance platform with the ability to selectively deploy underwriting capacity to optimize shareholder returns, with a commitment to innovation, client service and long-term relationships.

Our strategic focus centers on growing the fee income component of our Program Services business, which will increase our pre-tax income while effectively managing the continuing run-off of the legacy Maiden alternative asset and reinsurance portfolios.

We believe this will create the greatest risk-adjusted shareholder returns in order to increase pre-tax income and book value for our common shareholders, both near and long-term. Our assessment is that these areas of strategic focus would enhance our profitability through increased returns, which would also increase the likelihood of fully utilizing the significant net operating loss ("NOL") carryforwards, as described further below, which would increase both GAAP book value and create additional common shareholder value. The recognition of the deferred tax asset on our consolidated balance sheet remains a leading priority for the Company to increase its GAAP book value.

We may consider selectively deploying underwriting capacity to optimize shareholder returns in support of this business. We believe that may accelerate the growth of our Program Services segment and further optimize shareholder returns. Such underwriting capacity, which the Company is presently exploring, may be in conjunction with our existing insurance carrier partners or via other reinsurance mechanisms that would achieve the same objective.

As a result of the Combination, as of December 31, 2025, we own $218.6 million into alternative investments which include equity securities, equity method investments and other investments in a wide variety of asset classes. Please refer to the "Liquidity and Capital Resources" section on "Other Investments, Equity Method Investments and Equity Investments" for further information on these alternative asset classes and a detailed discussion of their investment returns. Recent developments and trends in financial markets, particularly the ongoing volatility in interest rates and the associated economic uncertainty as a result of those and other fiscal and monetary policy changes, indicate that it may take longer than expected to achieve those returns and we expect that to factor into future capital allocation decisions.

Prior to the Combination, Maiden had determined that this asset management strategy did not serve its longer-term strategic goals, which had shifted to a focus on developing or acquiring fee income oriented insurance operations and had ceased making commitments to these alternative asset classes and had begun to dispose of these investments. Subsequent to the Combination, we have continued to pursue this objective and seek to find appropriate opportunities to dispose of these assets and believe this is a high priority in support of focusing our efforts on growing our Program Services business.

The cash consideration and related significant professional expenses associated with completing the Combination, however utilized substantial amounts of Maiden's current unrestricted liquidity. Accordingly, we expect our alternative investment portfolio to be reduced in future periods as we believe it is critical to reposition our balance sheet and increase our liquidity in support of the current initiatives being pursued. We have not made, and do not expect to make any such additional commitments to alternative investments at this time.

While we believe that the Combination with Maiden will increase the likelihood of achieving our stated objectives, there can be no assurance that the run-off of its insurance liabilities will run-off at levels that will allow us to achieve those goals. Prior to the Combination, Maiden's run-off of its insurance liabilities had been more volatile than anticipated and it entered into a Loss Portfolio Transfer and Adverse Development Cover Agreement ("LPT/ADC Agreement") with Cavello Bay Reinsurance Limited ("Cavello"). Please see Note 8. Reinsurance of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data for further information regarding the Company's relationship with Cavello and an ongoing potential dispute between the parties, which could impact the run-off of Maiden's liabilities.

As a result, we continue to pursue finality solutions to resolve the AmTrust reinsurance liabilities not covered by the Loss Portfolio Transfer and Adverse Development Cover Agreement ("LPT/ADC Agreement"), including through third-parties. There can be no guarantee that we will execute such finality solutions and these solutions could involve significant charges to execute and we are actively evaluating the potential costs and benefits of such solutions, to the extent they are available to the Company.
Our business consists of two reportable segments: Program Services and Legacy Reinsurance.

Kestrel Group specializes in providing fronting services and offering issuing carrier capacity to insurance program managers, managing general agencies (MGAs), reinsurers, and reinsurance brokers who sell, control and administer books of

insurance business that are supported by third parties that assume reinsurance risk. Our Program Services segment consists of a cohesive suite of products and services offered by Kestrel that are integrated and interdependent. Kestrel Group facilitates these insurance transactions utilizing its exclusive management contracts with four insurance carriers, all of which are rated A- (Excellent) by A.M. Best Rating Services, Inc. ("A.M. Best") with a Financial Size Category of XV.

Kestrel Group continues to write business through its exclusive use of insurance carriers Sierra Specialty Insurance Company, Rochdale Insurance Company, Park National Insurance Company and Republic Fire and Casualty Insurance Company (collectively, "AmTrust Insurance Carriers"), all subsidiaries of AmTrust Financial Services, Inc. ("AmTrust"). Pursuant to the terms of the Combination Agreement, Kestrel retains the option to acquire the AmTrust Insurance Companies from AmTrust for a period of up to three years after closing of the Combination.

paragraphs: Our business is subject to a number of risks that could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition and/or liquidity and that could cause our operating results to vary significantly from period to period. The risks described below are not the only risks we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial also could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition and/or liquidity. Some statements in the risk factors constitute forward-looking statements.

Our ability to generate operating profits may be adversely affected by the level of our debt service obligations and operating expenses. We incur significant fixed costs, including interest and principal payments on outstanding indebtedness, as well as substantial operating expenses associated with maintaining our insurance operations, distribution channels, technology infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative functions. These obligations must be satisfied regardless of our revenue levels or underwriting performance.

As a result of the Combination, the Company has significant levels of debt service and operating expenses which Maiden had previously incurred. Maiden had issued debt when it was a significantly larger company with much higher revenue levels and that interest expense totals $19.1 million annually. The Company is also incurring significant levels of non-payroll expenditures related to multiple ongoing legal matters, costs associated with its reinsurance recoverables, corporate insurance and other expenditures. In addition, as a regulated, public company, the Company must maintain significant staffing levels to ensure it has an adequate control environment and can fulfill its obligations as a regulated public company. Despite current growth in the Company's Program Services agreement, our revenues are currently insufficient to offset those fixed costs. We continue to take measures to reduce expenses where appropriate and believe our revenue will continue to grow to an acceptable level to ultimately produce an operating profit, but it may take several periods for that to occur.

If our premium revenue, investment income, or other sources of operating income are insufficient to cover these costs, our operating results could be materially adversely affected. Elevated debt service requirements reduce our financial flexibility and may limit the capital available to support growth, invest in strategic initiatives, or absorb adverse developments in claims experience or investment performance. In addition, increases in interest rates, refinancing costs, or operating expenses could further increase our cost structure. As a result, our significant debt service and operating expense obligations may make it more difficult for us to achieve or sustain operating profitability, particularly during periods of unfavorable increased claims, adverse reserve development, lower investment returns, or broader economic or market volatility. If we are unable to generate sufficient income to meet these obligations while maintaining adequate capital levels required by regulators and rating agencies, our financial condition, results of operations, and business prospects could be materially adversely affected.

We are a specialty program group offering fronting arrangements to domestic and foreign insurers that want to access specific U.S. property and casualty insurance business, which are collectively referred to as "capacity providers," and we generally reinsure on a quota share basis up to 100% of the risk under these policies issued by the AmTrust Insurance Companies in exchange for fees. We presently write business exclusively through the AmTrust Insurance Companies, all subsidiaries of AmTrust through which we have been writing our business, and we currently have an option to acquire the AmTrust Insurance Companies from AmTrust.

The AmTrust Insurance Companies reinsure a substantial portion of the underwriting and operating risks in connection with our fronting arrangements to capacity providers. We generally recommend either well capitalized, highly rated authorized capacity providers or capacity providers that post collateral and/or obtain guarantees to secure the reinsured risks on the policies issued by the AmTrust Insurance Companies. However, if any of the capacity providers becomes insolvent, are unwilling or unable to post collateral, or otherwise refuse to reimburse losses paid to these policyholders in a timely manner, the corresponding impact to our ability to continue writing business through the AmTrust Insurance Companies could materially adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

paragraphs: 於 2025 年 5 月 27 日，Kestrel Group LLC（"Kestrel LLC"）與 Maiden Holdings, Ltd.（"Maiden"）完成其先前宣佈的組合（"組合"），成立一個新的公開上市專業方案羣組，營運名稱為 Kestrel Group Ltd（"Kestrel Group" 或 "母公司"）。此組合於 2024 年 12 月 30 日已先前公告。Maiden 股票於 2025 年 5 月 27 日 NASDAQ Capital Market（"Nasdaq"）收市時停止交易。Kestrel 股票於 2025 年 5 月 28 日 Nasdaq 開市時以 "KG" 編碼開始交易。於交易完成（"完成"）後，Maiden 與 Kestrel LLC 現已成為本公司之 wholly owned subsidiaries，本公司已重新品牌為 Kestrel Group 並更名為 "Kestrel Group Ltd"（"Kestrel"）。
此組合建立了一個輕資本、費用為基礎的保險平台，具備選擇性部署承保能力以優化股東回報的能力，並承諾創新、客戶服務與長期關係。
我們的戰略重點為成長我們 Program Services 商業之費用收入零組件，此將提高我們的稅前收入，同時有效管理持續運作中的 Maiden 替代資產與再保險投資組合。
我們相信這將創造最大的風險調整後股東回報，以提高稅前收入與普通股股東之帳面價值，近、遠期皆然。我們的評估是，這些戰略重點將透過提高回報來增強我們的獲利能力，這也會提高完全利用重大淨營業虧損（"NOL"）結轉的機率，如後文進一步說明，這將提高 GAAP 帳面價值並創造額外的普通股股東價值。本公司於合併財務報表中認列遞延所得稅資產，仍是本公司提高 GAAP 帳面價值的首要優先事項。
我們可能考慮選擇性部署承保能力以優化股東回報，以支持此業務。我們相信這可能加速我們 Program Services 分部的成長，並進一步優化股東回報。此承保能力，本公司目前正在探討，可能是與我們現有保險電信業者夥伴合作，或透過其他再保險機制來達成相同目標。

由於組合的完成，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們持有 218.6 百萬美元於替代投資，包括股權證券、權益法投資及其他投資於廣泛的資產類別。請參閱 "流動性與資本資源" 節中 "其他投資、權益法投資與股權投資" 部分，以取得這些替代資產類別的進一步資訊及詳細討論其投資回報。近期金融市場的發展與趨勢，特別是利率持續波動及因應這些及其他財政與貨幣政策變動所產生的經濟不確定性，顯示要達成這些回報可能需要比預期更長的時間，我們預期這會影響未來的資本配置決策。
在組合完成前，Maiden 已決定此資產管理策略無法符合其長期戰略目標，其戰略目標已轉向發展或取得以費用收入為導向的保險業務，並已停止對這些替代資產類別做出承諾，並開始處分這些投資。組合完成後，我們已持續追求此目標，並尋找適當的機會處分這些資產，我們認為這是支持我們專注於成長 Program Services 商業的首要優先事項。
然而，完成組合所涉及的現金對價及相關重大專業費用，已大量使用 Maiden 現有的未受限制流動性。因此，我們預期未來期間的替代投資組合將減少，我們認為這對重新定位資產負債表與提高流動性以支持目前進行的計畫至關重要。我們尚未做出，且不預期會做出任何進一步對替代投資的承諾。

雖然我們認為與 Maiden 的合併將提高達成我們所陳述目標的可能性，但無法保證 Maiden 的保險責任償付將達到足以達成這些目標的水準。在合併前，Maiden 的保險責任償付較預期更為波動，並與 Cavello Bay Reinsurance Limited（"Cavello"）簽訂了損失組合轉讓及不利發展覆蓋協議（"LPT/ADC 協議"）。請參閱財務會計彙編附註第 8 項：再保險，包含於第二部分第 8 項財務資料及補充資料中，以取得有關本公司與 Cavello 關係及雙方之間持續潛在爭議的進一步資訊，此爭議可能影響 Maiden 的責任償付。
因此，我們持續尋求最終解決方案以解決未被 LPT/ADC 協議涵蓋的 AmTrust 再保險責任，包括透過第三方。無法保證我們將執行此種最終解決方案，且這些解決方案可能涉及重大費用，我們正在積極評估這些解決方案對本公司而言的潛在成本與效益，如這些解決方案可供本公司使用。
本公司業務包含兩個應報告分部：程式服務與遺留再保險。

Kestrel Group 專注於提供前線服務，並為保險程式管理人、管理總代理（MGAs）、再保險公司及再保險經紀人提供發行者容量，這些經紀人銷售、控制並管理由第三方承擔再保險風險的保險業務。我們的程式服務分部包含 Kestrel 提供的一套整合且相互依存的產品與服務。Kestrel Group 藉助其與四家保險公司的獨家管理契約，促進這些保險交易，這些保險公司皆被 A.M. Best Rating Services, Inc.（"A.M. Best"）評為 A-（優秀），財務規模等級為 XV。

Kestrel Group 繼續透過其獨家使用保險公司 Sierra Specialty Insurance Company、Rochdale Insurance Company、Park National Insurance Company 及 Republic Fire and Casualty Insurance Company（合稱 "AmTrust 保險公司"），這些公司皆為 AmTrust Financial Services, Inc.（"AmTrust"）的子公司，來承寫業務。根據合併協議的條款，Kestrel 保留自 AmTrust 取得 AmTrust 保險公司的選擇權，此選擇權自合併完成後最多持續三年。
根據合併協議的條款，Kestrel 保留自 AmTrust 取得 AmTrust 保險公司的選擇權，此選擇權自合併完成後最多持續三年。

2025年5月27日，Kestrel Group LLC（「Kestrel LLC」）與Maiden Holdings, Ltd.（「Maiden」）完成其先前宣佈的組合（「組合」），成立一個新的公開上市專業方案羣組，並以Kestrel Group Ltd（「Kestrel Group」或「母公司」）之名運作。此組合於2024年12月30日已先前提及。Maiden股票於2025年5月27日NASDAQ資本市場（「NASDAQ」）收市時停止交易。Kestrel Group股票於2025年5月28日NASDAQ開盤時開始交易，股票代碼為「KG」。於交易完成（「交易完成」）後，Maiden與Kestrel LLC現為母公司之 wholly owned subsidiaries，母公司已重新品牌為Kestrel Group，並更名為「Kestrel Group Ltd」（「Kestrel」）。
此組合創造了一個資本輕量、以費用為基礎的保險平台，具備選擇性部署承保能力以優化股東回報的能力，並承諾創新、客戶服務與長期關係。
我們的戰略重點為成長我們方案服務業務的費用收入零組件，這將提高我們的稅前收入，同時有效管理遺留Maiden替代資產與再保險組合的持續減損。
我們對成長費用業務的關注可能包括但不限於選擇性部署承保能力以優化股東回報，以支持此業務。我們持續與現有夥伴合作，尋求再保險機制，以選擇性部署本公司的承保能力，並促進與加速我們方案服務分部的成長，以優化股東回報。
我們認為這將創造最大的風險調整後股東回報，以提高稅前收入與普通股東的帳本價值，無論短期或長期。我們的評估是，這些戰略重點將透過提高回報來增強我們的利潤，這也會提高完全利用重大淨-operating loss（「NOL」）結轉的機率，如後文進一步說明，這將提高GAAP帳本價值，並創造額外的普通股東價值。本公司在合併資產負債表上確認遞延所得稅資產的認列，仍是本公司提高GAAP帳本價值的首要優先事項。

由於組合的完成，截至2025年12月31日，我們持有218.6 百萬美元的替代投資，包括股權證券、權益法投資及其他投資於各種資產類別。請參閱「流動性與資本資源」部分中的「其他投資、權益法投資與權益投資」，以取得這些替代資產類別的進一步資訊及對其投資回報的詳細討論。金融市場的最新發展與趨勢，特別是利率持續波動及因這些及其他財政與貨幣政策變動所導致的經濟不確定性，顯示可能需要比預期更長的時間才能實現這些回報，我們預期這會影響未來的資本配置決策。
於組合前，Maiden 已決定此資產管理策略無法實現其長期戰略目標，其戰略已轉向專注於發展或取得以費用收入為導向的保險業務，並已停止對這些替代性資產類別做出承諾，並開始處置這些投資。於組合後，我們持續追求此目標，並尋找適當的機會處置這些資產，並認為這項工作是支持我們專注於成長 Program Services 業務的首要任務。
因此，我們預期未來期間的替代性投資組合規模將減少，因為我們認為重新定位資產負債表並增加流動性以支持目前進行的業務計畫至關重要。我們目前未做出任何對替代性投資的承諾，也預期未來不會做出任何這樣的承諾。

雖然我們認為與 Maiden 的組合將提高實現我們所陳述目標的可能性，但無法保證 Maiden 保險責任的償付金額能達到讓我們實現這些目標的水平。因此，我們持續尋求最終解決方案以解決未被 LPT/ADC 協議涵蓋的 AmTrust 責任，包括透過第三方。無法保證我們將執行這些最終解決方案，且這些解決方案可能涉及重大費用，我們正在積極評估這些解決方案的潛在成本與效益，若這些解決方案對本公司可用的話。
本公司目前不承擔未來再保險風險，但可能會選擇性地運用承保能力以優化股東回報，以支持本公司 Program Services 業務。請參閱第 1 項「業務 - 我們的應報告分部」部分，以進一步討論我們的應報告分部。

paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨許多風險，這些風險可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況及/或流動性造成重大不利影響，也可能導致本公司營運成果在不同期間產生顯著變動。下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或認為不重要，這些風險也可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況及/或流動性造成重大不利影響。部分風險因素陳述屬於展望性陳述。
本公司產生營運獲利的能力可能因債務償還義務及營運費用的水準而受到不利影響。本公司產生大量固定成本，包括對現有債務的利息及本金償還，以及與維持保險業務、銷售通路、資訊科技基礎設施、法規合規及行政功能相關的大量營運費用。這些義務必須無條件履行，與本公司營收水準或承保表現無關。

由於合併後的結果，本公司目前有相當程度的債務償還義務及營運費用，這些費用原先由Maiden承擔。Maiden在當時為一家規模較大、營收水準較高的公司時曾發行債務，且利息費用每年總計為19.1百萬美元。本公司同時也產生大量非薪資支出，與多項進行中的法律事務、再保險追償款項、公司保險及其他支出有關。此外，作為一家受監管的上市公司，本公司必須維持相當程度的人力配置，以確保擁有足夠的控制環境，並能履行作為受監管上市公司的義務。儘管本公司Program Services契約目前有成長，但目前營收尚不足以彌補這些固定成本。本公司持續在適當的情況下採取措施降低費用，並相信營收將持續成長至可接受的水準，以最終產生營運獲利，但可能需要幾個期間才能實現。

如果本公司 premiums 收入、投資收益或其他營運收入不足以彌補這些成本，本公司營運成果可能受到重大不利影響。高昂的債務償還需求會降低本公司財務彈性，並可能限制可用於支持成長、投資戰略計畫或吸收保單經驗或投資表現不利變動的資金。此外，利率上漲、再融資成本或營運費用的增加，可能會進一步提高本公司成本結構。因此，本公司重大債務償還及營運費用義務，可能使本公司在遭遇保單經驗不利、備抵賠款發展不良、投資回報降低或總體經濟或市場波動增加的期間，更難以達成或維持營運獲利。如果本公司無法在維持監管機構與評級機構所要求的充足資本水準的同時，產生足夠收入以償還這些義務，本公司財務狀況、營運成果及業務前景可能受到重大不利影響。

本公司為一家專門的程式組，提供美國本土與外國保險公司，以取得特定美國財產與責任保險業務的前線安排，這些業務 collectively 稱為 "capacity providers"，我們通常以quota share方式再保險，至多承擔這些保單由AmTrust Insurance Companies所發行的風險的100%，並收取費用。本公司目前僅透過AmTrust Insurance Companies來承寫業務，所有子公司均為AmTrust所擁有，我們目前有機會從AmTrust取得AmTrust Insurance Companies。

AmTrust Insurance Companies再保險與本公司前線安排至capacity providers相關的大部分承保與營運風險。我們通常建議使用資本充足、評價高的授權capacity providers，或提供擔保或抵押品的capacity providers，以確保由AmTrust Insurance Companies所發行保單的再保險風險。然而，如果任何capacity providers成為破產、拒絕或無法提供抵押品，或以其他方式拒絕及時償還支付給這些保單持有人的損失，則對本公司持續透過AmTrust Insurance Companies承寫業務的能力產生的影響，可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
